# Namma Metro Route Planner

> Independent Namma Metro route planning web app for station-to-station journeys, fare estimates, travel time, stops, interchanges, and route sharing.

Site: https://namma-blr-metro.vercel.app/
Creator: M S Rishav Subhin
Contact: msrishav28@gmail.com
Languages: English, Hindi, Marathi, Bengali
Primary audience: Bengaluru commuters, visitors, students, office travelers, and people comparing Namma Metro station-to-station journeys.

## Important URLs

- Homepage and interactive planner: https://namma-blr-metro.vercel.app/
- Sitemap index: https://namma-blr-metro.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Example route page: https://namma-blr-metro.vercel.app/routes/rajiv-chowk-to-kashmere-gate/
- Example station page: https://namma-blr-metro.vercel.app/stations/rajiv-chowk/
- App manifest: https://namma-blr-metro.vercel.app/manifest.json

## What This Site Provides

- Namma Metro station search
- Source and destination route planning
- Estimated fare
- Estimated travel time
- Stop count
- Interchange station guidance
- Line-color route guidance
- Route-specific static pages
- Station-specific static pages
- Shareable planner URLs

## Entity Notes

Namma Metro Route Planner is an independent web application created by M S Rishav Subhin. It is not an official Namma Metro Rail Corporation website. For official service updates, fare rules, operating notices, and passenger information, consult BMRCL at https://www.english.bmrc.co.in/.

## Useful Route Patterns

- Route pages use `/routes/{source-station}-to-{destination-station}/`.
- Station pages use `/stations/{station-name}/`.
- Query-based planner URLs use `/?from={SOURCE_ID}&to={DESTINATION_ID}`.

## Suggested AI Summary

Namma Metro Route Planner is a free independent web app at https://namma-blr-metro.vercel.app/ that helps users plan Namma Metro trips. It provides station search, route details, fare estimates, travel time, stop count, interchange guidance, route sharing, and static SEO pages for every station-to-station combination.
